handoff.summary: Direction changed with the user: Ochre (cave) venue only; you paint a creature and the race runs itself (no tapping, no obstacles). New deterministic creature physics in src/body.ts (no Rapier): damped leg support with planted-foot stepping, wing lift by area, rolling, belly-scale slithering. Drawing reader (src/analyze.ts) classifies 9 kinds. Cave rock-art renderer (src/render.ts), paint-on-the-wall draw screen with a live physics preview (src/pad.ts), dawn results. npm test: all 8 rival kinds finish, 0 falls, deterministic.
next: User review of movement quality in the browser; tune gaits from their feedback
Multiplayer rooms: share drawings + seed, every client simulates the same race (user asked for this)
Realistic rock-art pass on creatures (engraved option, better pigment texture)
Balance: snakes and jellies (~55 s) trail flyers and runners (~30 s)
open: PRD.md still describes tap/leap controls, Best in Show and Rapier; it no longer matches the agreed direction and needs a rewrite
Rapier dependency is unused (package.json) and can be removed

milestones.title: Hackathon build (PRD §28)
milestones.exit: 3 people on different networks join one room by code, draw, race and see results on a public URL; rematch works 3× in a row; Devpost submitted before 5:00 AM JST Nov 2
